ja370:1.1: Haṃso palāsam avaca: nigrodho samma jāyati, aṃkasmiṃ te nisinno va so te mammāni checchatīti.
ja370:2.1: Vaḍḍhatām eva nigrodho, patiṭṭh' assa bhavām' ahaṃ yathā pitā vā mātā vā, evam eso bhavissatīti.
ja370:3.1: Yaṃ tvaṃ aṃkasmiṃ vaḍḍhesi khīrarukkhaṃ bhayānakaṃ āmanta kho taṃ gacchāma vaḍḍhi-m-assa na ruccatīti.
ja370:4.1: Idāni kho maṃ bhāyati Mahāneru-nidassanaṃ, haṃsassa anabhiññāya mahā me bhayam āgatan ti.
ja370:5.1: Na tassa vaḍḍhi kusalappasatthā yo vaḍḍhamāno ghasate patiṭṭhaṃ, tass' ūparodhaṃ parisaṃkamāno patārayī mūlavadhāya dhīro ti
